_comment: Registry for /c/<code> campaign redirects, read by the members auth service (automation/members-area/auth_service/app.py). Same shape and same reasoning as workoutLinks.json: the operator owns the path, so a destination can be repointed after the email has been sent and cannot be un-sent. UNLIKE workoutLinks.json these destinations are ABSOLUTE and may be off-site -- that is the whole point: a TrainingPeaks checkout runs no GA4 of ours, so a server-side redirect is the only way a click on it is ever counted. An unknown code NEVER 404s; it falls back to `fallback` below and is still logged under its own code. Add a code here and it is live on the next git pull -- the service re-reads on mtime, no restart.
